subject: [PATCH 5/5] selftests/nfsd: exercise the userspace-rpcbind listener_set flag

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch adds a series of tests to the selftests/nfsd suite to exercise various features and edge cases related to the userspace-rpcbind listener_set flag. The tests cover scenarios such as skipping rpcbind registration, handling NFSv4 and NFSv3 protocols, ownership rules, and error conditions. The patch also updates the genl_request_reply function to handle attribute arguments in the reply message. Overall, this patch aims to ensure that the userspace-rpcbind listener_set flag is properly handled by the kernel and that the selftests/nfsd suite can cover a wide range of scenarios related to NFS services.
